samples.summary: Removing the per-block `Math.min(8,…)` / `Math.max(0,…)` clamps leaves out-of-range `listLevel` values from the unvalidated CRDT read path (`crdt-tree.ts:243` does a bare `Number(attrs.listLevel)`) to persist and flow into layout arithmetic
samples.evidence: Remote/collaborative document state is parsed at packages/docs/src/model/crdt-tree.ts:243 with `if ('listLevel' in attrs) block.listLevel = Number(attrs.listLevel);` — no clamp, no NaN/finite check, no range check (the clipboard path DOES clamp, clipboard.ts:351 `Math.min(MAX_LIST_LEVEL, Math.max(0, Math.trunc(level)))`). Before this change every indent/outdent write ran a per-block clamp (`Math.min(8, cur+1)` / `Math.max(0, cur-1)` in the old handleTab, and `if (cur >= MAX_LIST_LEVEL) return` / `if (cur <= 0) return` in the handlers), which incidentally normalised a hostile value back into range on the next gesture. The new planner only *refuses* out-of-range subtrees (list-level.ts:73-74) and otherwise writes `(listLevel ?? 0) + delta` verbatim (list-level.ts:79), so a peer-supplied `listLevel` of `-5`, `1e9`, or `NaN` is now preserved and re-committed through `doc.setBlockType` in all six handlers. Downstream consumers do unchecked arithmetic on it — layout.ts:494 `LIST_INDENT_PX * ((block.listLevel ?? 0) + 1)`, table-layout.ts:93, pdf-painter.ts:366, markdown.ts:140 `'  '.repeat(Math.max(0, block.listLevel ?? 0))` (a huge value here is an allocation blow-up on export). Attack: a collaborator with write access to a shared doc (or a crafted Yorkie snapshot) writes `listLevel: 1e9` or `NaN`; every other client's layout/export path consumes it. Impact is document/render corruption and a possible export-time memory blow-up rather than a confidentiality or auth break, and the missing validation itself is pre-existing at crdt-tree.ts:243 — this change only removes the accidental normalisation, so confidence is low.
searchedFor: Grep 'listLevel' across packages/docs/src (all read and write sites)
Grep 'MAX_LIST_LEVEL' across packages/ (only list-level.ts and clipboard.ts define/enforce it)
Grep 'setBlockType' in packages/docs/src/model/document.ts and store/memory.ts:321-338 — store assigns `opts?.listLevel ?? 0` with no range check
Read packages/docs/src/store/read-only.ts (write gate) and packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts MUTATING_METHODS list
